benefits: Supports mental clarity and sustained focus

en.usage: Start low: 1-3 drops (roughly 0.5-1 mg) held under the tongue for 30-60 seconds, once daily. Assess tolerance before increasing gradually. Do not exceed the amount recommended on the label. Methylene blue can temporarily tint urine or saliva blue-green — this is normal.
en.safety: Consult your doctor before use, especially if you are pregnant, nursing, or have a medical condition. Do not use with MAOIs, SSRIs, SNRIs, or other serotonergic medications due to the risk of serotonin syndrome. Not intended for children. Discontinue use and consult a physician if you experience any adverse reaction.

faq.question: Is Methylene Blue safe to take daily?
faq.answer: At the low, titrated doses used for wellness support, many people use it daily. Because it interacts with several medication classes, we recommend checking with your doctor before starting a daily routine.

faq.question: Why does my urine or saliva turn blue-green?
faq.answer: This is a normal, harmless effect of methylene blue being excreted by the body. It is not a sign of a problem and typically fades within a day.

faq.question: Can I take this with antidepressants?
faq.answer: No. Methylene blue is a monoamine oxidase inhibitor and should not be combined with SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, or other serotonergic medications without explicit medical supervision, due to the risk of serotonin syndrome.

faq.question: How quickly will I notice an effect?
faq.answer: Some people report a subtle sense of mental clarity within an hour of a dose; individual response varies and this product is not intended to produce a stimulant-like effect.

faq.question: Pourquoi mon urine ou ma salive devient-elle bleu-vert ?
faq.answer: C'est un effet normal et sans danger lié à l'élimination du bleu de méthylène par l'organisme. Cela disparaît généralement en une journée.

faq.question: Puis-je le prendre avec des antidépresseurs ?
faq.answer: Non. Le bleu de méthylène est un inhibiteur de la monoamine oxydase et ne doit pas être associé aux ISRS, IRSN, IMAO ou autres médicaments sérotoninergiques sans supervision médicale explicite, en raison du risque de syndrome sérotoninergique.

faq.question: Combien de temps avant de ressentir un effet ?
faq.answer: Certaines personnes rapportent une sensation subtile de clarté mentale dans l'heure suivant la prise ; la réponse varie selon les individus et ce produit n'est pas destiné à produire un effet stimulant.
